title: Remote config (config.json on S3 behind CloudFront)
description: Read by the web app at load and every 2 minutes, and by the relay on every job (cached 30 s). Changing it is uploading a file; no deploy. It is public: never put event codes, keys or handles in it. Event codes and the blocked list live in Secrets Manager / the relay's DynamoDB table.

routing.description: Per op, providers in order of preference, on the event's keys. The relay sends a job to the first one whose capability sheet supports the op and that has a free slot; the UI shows controls from the first provider's sheet. An empty list turns the op off. For the event every op routes to ['runway'] only: fal and HeyGen run only on a participant's own keys (flags.ownKeys). When an op routes to runway, Runway is the floor of every job for it, own-key jobs and picks included: a job that fails on another provider for a provider or account reason is made again once on Runway's default model (features/runway-fallback.clan, 2026-10-09).

fallbackOnly.description: No longer read (2026-10-09, features/runway-fallback.clan): Runway is the floor of every job and its models are always offered, so nothing is fallback-only. Still accepted so a config.json that names it keeps validating on a relay that has moved on; drop it from the live config, then from this schema. Was: providers never offered in the regenerate menu, the fallback for a failed pick.

queueTimeoutS.description: How long a job may wait in the queue for a free provider slot before it fails, per class (seconds). Optional: absent, the relay uses 1800 for image and video. jobTimeoutS still bounds a job once it runs.

capUsd.description: Global stop: new paid jobs are refused with spend_stop once confirmed + reserved reaches it.

flags.description: Kill switches and the D7 go/no-go flags. A control appears only when its flag is on AND the routed provider's sheet supports it.

ownKeys.description: Participants may send their own fal and HeyGen keys (X-Own-Keys on POST /jobs). Optional; absent means off.

dogfood.description: The beta's record (features/production-tool-dogfood.clan): the notice, the Beta tag and the thumbs in the web app, and POST /dogfood/* on the relay. Optional; absent means off.
